page_title: ACM 2-2 FIO | AC Milan v Fiorentina 05/04/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' That's it for today, Giovanni Ayroldi has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+6' Malick Thiaw (AC Milan) finds himself beyond the last defender but the linesman raises his flag for offside.
90+5' Total attempts – 19:15. The current number of shots on goal is 6:8.

90+4' Luca Ranieri (Fiorentina) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Giovanni Ayroldi blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion. AC Milan earn a free kick which could lead to a goal-scoring opportunity.
90+2' Referee halts the game and wanders over to the touchline to talk to Raffaele Palladino, then promptly shows him a RED CARD!
90' 5 additional min. will be played.
90' The referee looks satisfied after his VAR review and duly disallows the goal for offside. The Fiorentina players look gutted.
90' Wait! Referee Giovanni Ayroldi has indicated he is going to review the Fiorentina goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was an offside in the build-up.
89' An absolutely sensational volley by Dodo (Fiorentina). He took a shot from inside the penalty area and the ball went in just under the crossbar. All credit to Dodo (Fiorentina), excellent finish.
88' Substitution. Rolando Mandragora did his best and is replaced by Yacine Adli (Fiorentina).
87' Samuel Chukwueze (AC Milan) takes the corner with a short pass.

87' Tijjani Reijnders almost gets into in a promising position, but the through ball by Samuel Chukwueze (AC Milan) from just inside the box is intercepted by one of the defending players. The ball goes out for a corner. AC Milan can continue in their attacking effort.

86' Moise Kean (Fiorentina) blows a good opportunity. He has a lot of space around him and fires a terrific shot from the edge of the box towards the left side of the goal, but the goalkeeper makes a brilliant save and stops this one!
85' Half-chance! Cher Ndour (Fiorentina) plays a pass into the box, but Mike Maignan reacts well to snuff out the attack.
84' Wasted effort! Theo Hernandez (AC Milan) finds himself some space, looks up but sends a dreadful shot high over the bar from long range.

83' Moise Kean (Fiorentina) rises above the opponent's defence and heads a precise cross towards the middle of the goal. His effort, however, is blocked by Mike Maignan, who pulls off a comfortable save!
82' Lucas Beltran (Fiorentina) misses a huge chance from inside the penalty area after unleashing a powerful first-time volley towards goal that goes well wide of the right post.
80' Santiago Tomas Gimenez (AC Milan) has picked up an injury and is replaced by Joao Felix.
80' Sergio Conceicao prepares a substitution. Christian Pulisic is replaced by Samuel Chukwueze (AC Milan).
80' Here comes a substitution. Youssouf Fofana is given a rest as he is replaced by Warren Bondo (AC Milan).
75' Moise Kean (Fiorentina) fires the ball on goal but sends it into orbit.
75' Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence.
74' Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.

74' Theo Hernandez (AC Milan) bursts into the box after a fine solo run. He looks up and tries to place a shot into the bottom left corner, but David de Gea makes a great save to deny him his moment of glory. AC Milan get a corner.
72' Here is a change. Fabiano Parisi is going off and Raffaele Palladino gives the last tactical orders to Michael Folorunsho (Fiorentina).
72' Substitution. Pietro Comuzzo (Fiorentina) in, Marin Pongracic out.
70' Rolando Mandragora (Fiorentina) receives a reproachful look from Lucas Beltran. He latches on to his pass, but the effort from the edge of the box sails high over the crossbar.
69' Nicolo Fagioli (Fiorentina) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear.
69' Mike Maignan was forced into action to thwart Moise Kean (Fiorentina). He found himself some space after latching on to a pass and unleashed a shot to the right post but couldn't beat the keeper.
68' Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
67' A snap shot by Youssouf Fofana (AC Milan) from distance flies well wide of the right post.

66' This is an obvious ploy to delay the restart of play from David de Gea (Fiorentina). David de Gea (Fiorentina) is rightly booked by the referee because it could not have been anything other than a yellow card.
66' Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) rolls the ball short to a teammate from the corner instead of sending a cross into the box.
65' Youssouf Fofana (AC Milan) attempts to find his teammate with a final pass from outside of the box, but one of the defenders clears the ball to safety. Now AC Milan have a corner.
64' 2 - 2 Luka Jovic (AC Milan) latches on to a precise pass deep inside the box from Fikayo Tomori, and he beats the goalkeeper with a low accurate shot into the bottom left corner. He makes it 2:2.

63' Lucas Beltran (Fiorentina) latches on to a precise pass and finds himself one-on-one with the keeper. He fires a low shot towards the left side of the net, but Mike Maignan leaps like a salmon to deny him.
62' The total number of attempts is 12:7. 4:4 - the latest stats for both teams in respect of shots on target.
60' Lucas Beltran (Fiorentina) is clearly in an offside position after the ball is played through to him and the linesman raises his flag.
60' Nicolo Fagioli (Fiorentina) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender.
59' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Cher Ndour (Fiorentina) is coming onto the pitch as Danilo Cataldi cannot continue after picking up an injury.
59' Raffaele Palladino has decided to substitute Albert Gudmundsson and he is replaced by Lucas Beltran (Fiorentina).
58' Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) is given a fully deserved yellow card.
58' Whoa! Such gestures are commonly penalised and Rafael Leao (AC Milan) duly receives a yellow card.

56' Tijjani Reijnders (AC Milan) receives a slide-rule pass inside the box and has just the keeper to beat. His shot low towards the middle of the goal lacks power and David de Gea easily makes the save. Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) gets to the rebound inside the box and shoots to the bottom left corner, but his sidefooter is blocked by an alert David de Gea. What a save! Santiago Tomas Gimenez (AC Milan) latches onto a rebound in the box and fires a shot a whisker wide of the left post. That was a promising chance and maybe he should have done better!
55' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Santiago Tomas Gimenez (AC Milan) replaces Tammy Abraham.
55' Rafael Leao (AC Milan) breaks into the box and goes over after a challenge from an opposition player, but the ref signals NO penalty!
53' Luka Jovic (AC Milan) connects with a cross and has an effort on goal from the edge of the box, but his attempt goes well wide of the left post.
53' Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders.
52' David de Gea makes a superb save to deny a header which was nodded towards the left-hand post by Tammy Abraham (AC Milan) after a cross from the side.
52' Rolando Mandragora (Fiorentina) latches on to an accurate pass into the box and immediately unleashes a low shot goalwards. His effort is well saved by the keeper.

51' Moise Kean (Fiorentina) unleashes a promising shot towards the right side of the goal after his wonderful solo run, but Mike Maignan thwarts the effort with a fabulous save. The score remains the same.
50' Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) takes the corner and sends it into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and makes a good clearance.
49' The corner kick from Theo Hernandez (AC Milan) is headed out of the penalty area by one of the defenders.

48' Kyle Walker (AC Milan) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to AC Milan.
47' Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.

46' Rafael Leao (AC Milan) expertly controls the pass inside the penalty area and shoots, but it's inadvertently blocked a defender. AC Milan force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+5' Giovanni Ayroldi has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+4' Rolando Mandragora (Fiorentina) sends over a free kick from long range but the defence is alert.
45+4' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Kyle Walker (AC Milan) was quite harsh and Giovanni Ayroldi didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
45+2' Rafael Leao (AC Milan) plays a one-two with Christian Pulisic, but the move breaks down.
45+1' Fabiano Parisi (Fiorentina) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
45' We will have 4 min. of added time.
44' Fabiano Parisi (Fiorentina) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
43' The ball is in the net but it’s immediately ruled out by referee Giovanni Ayroldi due to a foul, much to the disappointment of the Luca Ranieri (Fiorentina) and his team.
42' A horde of players are waiting inside the penalty area for a cross from the corner, but Rolando Mandragora (Fiorentina) takes it short.
41' Theo Hernandez (AC Milan) gives the referee no choice but to show him a yellow card.
41' This is a yellow card! Dodo (Fiorentina) is not happy with the decision, but from our point of view it was clear.
41' Dodo (Fiorentina) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The ball goes out of play and AC Milan will have a goal kick.
40' Tammy Abraham (AC Milan) plays a through ball but overhits it. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Fiorentina.
35' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 3:4. The current number of shots on goal is 1:2.
33' Dodo (Fiorentina) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play. The ball goes out of play and AC Milan will have a goal kick.
33' Rolando Mandragora (Fiorentina) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.
32' Dodo (Fiorentina) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Fiorentina.
31' Pablo Mari (Fiorentina) receives a yellow card from the referee as expected. Pablo Mari (Fiorentina) will miss the next game because of that yellow card.
30' Youssouf Fofana (AC Milan) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Giovanni Ayroldi signals. A free kick to Fiorentina.
30' Danilo Cataldi (Fiorentina) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
28' Moise Kean (Fiorentina) is repeatedly being caught offside, but this is to be expected given that he always plays on the shoulder of the last defender.
26' Rafael Leao (AC Milan) commits a foul and Giovanni Ayroldi immediately signals a free kick.
26' Youssouf Fofana (AC Milan) connects with a pass but sees his shot from the edge of the box blocked.
25' Tammy Abraham (AC Milan) receives a neat pass inside the box and instantly thumps the ball goalward, but a defender makes a last ditch block to deny him.
23' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Yunus Musah departs the field of play to be replaced by Luka Jovic (AC Milan).
23' 1 - 2 Goal! Christian Pulisic plays a simple square pass into the feet of Tammy Abraham (AC Milan) in the box, who composes himself and lashes the ball into the bottom right corner. 1:2.
22' The resulting corner from Rolando Mandragora (Fiorentina) only finds one of the defenders, who heads it out of danger.

21' Albert Gudmundsson (Fiorentina) finds himself some space just outside the box, collects a rebound and sends an effort in on goal. Mike Maignan pulls off a fantastic reflex save to stop the ball going into the bottom right corner. Fiorentina win a corner.
19' Rafael Leao (AC Milan) breaks past challenges inside the box, but puts too much pace on his pass to Tammy Abraham.
17' Tijjani Reijnders (AC Milan) is in a clear offside position and the linesman raises his flag.
17' Dodo (Fiorentina) is free in the box and Albert Gudmundsson finds him with a pass, but his powerful shot skims just past the right post. Good chance!
15' Giovanni Ayroldi interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Marin Pongracic (Fiorentina). AC Milan are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
14' Tammy Abraham (AC Milan) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
13' The game is interrupted now, Tammy Abraham (AC Milan) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
10' 0 - 2 Goal! Dodo passes the ball to the feet of Moise Kean (Fiorentina), who has an empty net in front of him and has no problems in tapping the ball in. 0:2.
7' 0 - 1 This is definitely not what Malick Thiaw (AC Milan) wanted. Attempting to intercept an offensive pass, he scored an own goal and made it 0:1.
4' Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) sends a long cross over to Tijjani Reijnders, but David de Gea comes forward to gather the ball.
2' Moise Kean (Fiorentina) is in a clear offside position and the referee blows his whistle after the linesman raises his flag.
1' The first half has started.
Fiorentina will kick-off.
Giovanni Ayroldi is the one to supervise the game today.
